title: BND-1: Package the containment boundary as a container or sandbox (the selling point)
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** boundary --drill green on main
**Done check:** grep:Dockerfile::boundary --drill
**Status:** open

Ultrastable instances run inside a container or Cloudflare sandbox so agents create and destroy at will; egress (credentials, money, owner accounts, public publishing, third-party systems) stays gated. Doctrine: doctrine/boundary.json. Drill: python3 -m foundation boundary --drill.
